lines.2: 「Kid, you've been talking to the Princess a lot lately.」
lines.4: 「Finally fallen for her for real? Hmm?」
lines.5: 「If you asked whether I've fallen for her, I think I have been for a while.」
lines.6: 「I'd like to get closer to her.」
lines.9: 「You're on completely different levels. You and the Princess? Come on.」
lines.10: 「In fantasy-world terms, you're no more than a lowly merchant. Shut up and sell your herbs.」
lines.11: 「That makes you a monster! The worst kind, too--the one that steals your items and runs away!」
lines.12: 「Big talk from a guy whose hidden talent is the kendama! You wanna fight?!」
lines.13: 「Fighting Crab won't get you any closer to the Princess.」
lines.15: 「Now that you mention it, you do.」
lines.17: 「Leo the fake cynic, always insisting he won't get swept up in the moment, is finally trying to act.」
lines.19: 「For starters, talk to her more. Get to know her.」
lines.20: 「Luckily, the Princess seems to like you well enough.」
lines.21: 「Nah. I think she's just making fun of him.」
lines.22: 「You don't have to strip away the whole premise!」
lines.23: 「Still, it's true she finds you easy to talk to. And Yoppi, who's always with the Princess, talks to you a lot too.」
lines.24: 「You're aiming for a high-level woman. That's not a bad starting position.」
lines.25: 「We are in the same class, after all.」
lines.26: 「That advice sounds strangely convincing from you, Subaru.」
lines.27: 「Just do something concrete. Tomorrow, ask to join them for lunch.」
lines.29: 「Nice wimping. That's the Leo I know.」
lines.30: 「Isn't that raising the difficulty too fast?」
lines.31: 「Don't overthink it. Go as a friend. You're all on the council.」
lines.32: 「If the Princess is in a good mood tomorrow, I think you'll make it as far as eating together.」
lines.34: 「Idiot! What, you think the Princess will leap into your arms if you just wait?」
lines.37: 「You dream too much. Listen, kid. If you're afraid of getting hurt, your relationship will never go anywhere.」
lines.38: 「Ooh, good line. I'm stealing that one.」
lines.39: 「We'll gather up your bones afterward. Charge in without fear.」
lines.40: 「I bet my entire fortune--ten thousand yen--that he fails.」
lines.41: 「I bet ten thousand yen that he fails too! That's absolutely the winning side!」
lines.43: 「That's not even a wager. You really gonna let these two make that big a fool of you?」
lines.44: 「This pisses me off. I refuse to be mocked by these two.」
lines.45: 「Well, even failure is part of youth.」
lines.49: 「...Well, a friend is calling, so I'm off.」
lines.50: 「(His night job... He's got it rough too.)」
lines.51: 「Ah, youth. Instead of a sweet-and-sour memory, this one's looking pretty salty.」
lines.53: All I had to do was eat lunch with them!
